commitMessage:
[Performance] PropertyManager2 iterates the tree for infinite depth for
deleting/moving an IFile #468

Changing the depth from infinite to zeroth level for IFile resource
deletion

Fixes https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/468
dslRule:
<!id: resource.delete.depth.optimize>
<!description: Optimizes the resource property deletion depth from DEPTH_INFINITE to DEPTH_ZERO for IFile resources that have an associated project. This prevents unnecessary deep tree iteration for files.>
<!severity: INFO>
<!tags: performance, resource>

$manager.deleteProperties($target, org.eclipse.core.resources.IResource.DEPTH_INFINITE)
=> $manager.deleteProperties($target, org.eclipse.core.resources.IResource.DEPTH_ZERO) :: instanceof($target, "org.eclipse.core.resources.IFile") && isNonNull($target.getProject())
=> $manager.deleteProperties($target, org.eclipse.core.resources.IResource.DEPTH_INFINITE) :: otherwise
;;
summary: Optimize resource property deletion depth for IFile by changing DEPTH_INFINITE to DEPTH_ZERO when the target is an IFile with a non-null project.

commitMessage:
Check preconditions in FileSystemResourceManager.write #103

The FileSystemResourceManager.write() method fails when the target file
has been deleted before the write method has been called. The method
defines the existence of the file in the workspace as a precondition but
does never check that, which makes the method fail when first accessing
information that is not available after the deletion, in particular, its
ResourceInfo. This is why the method failed when accessing the
ResourceInfo.

The FileSystemResourceManagerTest.testWriteFile() randomly fails because
of this behavior. A concurrently running workspace refresh removes the
file right before the write() method is called.

- Make write() check its precondition, i.e., the existence of the target
file to deterministically fail with an IllegalStateException
- Make testWriteFile() wait for the refresh to be finished before
executing write() to have deterministic test behavior
- Add additional test case validating proper failure of write() when
target file has been deleted before

Fixes https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/103
summary: The commit introduces null checks and conditional error handling logic, which is beyond the scope of the current DSL's capabilities for structural changes.

commitMessage:
ProjectPreferences: intern() qualifier

to safe some memory from duplicate strings
dslRule:
<!id: string.intern-field-assignment>
<!description: Intern string expressions assigned to fields to save memory from duplicate strings, avoiding literals and nulls.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: performance, string>

$field = $stringExpression
=> $field = $stringExpression.intern()
:: isField($field)
:: instanceof($field, "java.lang.String")
:: instanceof($stringExpression, "java.lang.String")
:: isNonNull($stringExpression)
:: !isLiteral($stringExpression)
;;

commitMessage:
Unify additional auto-save actions across projects

Currently, each project configures its own additional auto-save actions
(or none at all). This change unifies the enabled actions across all
projects.
This includes the default settings applied by JDT tooling with the
following derivations:
* sp_cleanup.use_blocks=false
  Convert control statement bodies to block; disabled since too many
files do not yet follow this formatting guideline
* sp_cleanup.also_simplify_lambda=true
  Simplify lambda expression and method reference syntax
* sp_cleanup.convert_functional_interfaces=true
  Use lambda where possible and simplify expression

The following options are enabled as default by JDT:
* Change non static accesses to static members using declaring type
* Change indirect accesses to static members to direct accesses
(accesses through subtypes)
* Convert to enhanced 'for' loops only if the loop variable is used
* Convert to enhanced 'for' loops
* Primitive type rather then wrapper class
* Remove unused imports
* Add missing '@Override' annotations
* Add missing '@Override' annotations to implementations of interface
methods
* Add missing '@Deprecated' annotations
* Remove unnecessary casts
* Remove redundant semicolons
* Remove unnecessary '$NON-NLS$' tags
* Remove trailing white spaces on all lines
* Boolean value rather than comparison
* Single 'if' statement rather than duplicate blocks that fall through
* Use diamond operator
dslRule:
<!id: boolean.value.comparison.true>
<!description: Replace 'boolean == true' with 'boolean' for clarity and brevity.>
<!severity: HINT>
$x == true :: (instanceof($x, "boolean") || instanceof($x, "java.lang.Boolean")) && hasNoSideEffect($x)
=>
$x
;;

<!id: boolean.value.comparison.false>
<!description: Replace 'boolean == false' with '!boolean' for clarity and brevity.>
<!severity: HINT>
$x == false :: (instanceof($x, "boolean") || instanceof($x, "java.lang.Boolean")) && hasNoSideEffect($x)
=>
!$x
;;
